title: [DEV-M] Widget is still broken
symptom: Widget cannot be shown on Galaxy S10 (Android 10) and S22 Ultra (Android 13) using Dev M Build F905d7b594. Also fails in virtual emulator with Android Q.
cause: The opacity of the widget is set to zero by default.
fix: Adjust the opacity setting to make the widget visible.
evidence_quote: looks like the opacity is set to zero by default.. adjusting it makes it work in the physical and virtual devices.
